subcategory: Historic Suspension Bridge & Yoga Capital of the World
description: An iconic 450-foot iron suspension bridge spanning the emerald Ganges River, surrounded by the towering 13-storey Trayambakeshwar Temple, world-renowned yoga ashrams, river beaches, and white-water rafting launching points.
why_visit: Experience world-class white water river rafting on the holy Ganges, practice meditation at authentic Himalayan yoga ashrams, and watch the mesmerizing evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.
best_time_to_visit: September to June (White water rafting October to May)
activities: White Water Rafting; Yoga & Meditation; Bungee Jumping; Evening Ganga Aarti; Cafe Hopping
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 25 km from Haridwar / 45 km from Dehradun
notes: A brand new glass-floor pedestrian bridge (Bajrang Setu) is being completed parallel to the heritage bridge.
